Message:
KVM: fix the errno of ioctl KVM_[UN]REGISTER_COALESCED_MMIO failure

This patch change the errno of ioctl KVM_[UN]REGISTER_COALESCED_MMIO
from -EINVAL to -ENXIO if no coalesced mmio dev exists.
